text.p: Swiss construction and cement concern Holderbank Financiere Glarus Ltd reiterated that it expected its results to at least match those of 1996 but clarified a statement it released on Friday.
A Holderbank spokesman said that the results in question were not those after special provisions.

"If we are talking about future results of Holderbank for 1997, we compare net profit to the previous year and that means 646 million Swiss francs and not the 196 million francs after specific provisions and valuation adjustments," said Roland Walker.
On Friday, Holderbank said in a statement it expected results to at least match those of 1996. But the statement did not specify exactly which results were meant.
